name: luanti-org/luanti
description: Luanti (formerly Minetest) is an open-source voxel game-creation platform with easy modding and game creation via Lua scripting. Supports a full content ecosystem via ContentDB.

summary: Open-source voxel platform with Lua modding and massive content ecosystem
